results.step: pick list lists the shipment lines with warehouse on-hand + barcode
pick list is addressed from the main warehouse to the right store
the store manager may read the pick list of their own shipment
Pending -> Picking with a PARTIAL pick recorded
picking posts NO stock movement (stock stays at the warehouse)
picking MORE than approved is refused
results.detail: 417 frappe.exceptions.ValidationError: Picked more than approved for KRT-001

results.step: the pick can be completed to the full approved quantity
Picking -> Packed with parcels and a weight
a parcel with zero weight is refused
results.detail: 417 frappe.exceptions.ValidationError: Parcel weight must be positive

results.step: packing posts NO stock movement
buying a label returns a tracking number + label URL and leaves the status at Packed
results.detail: simulated USPS Ground Advantage $9.85 tracking=9400119277101014222172 status=Packed tracking_status=PRE_TRANSIT

results.step: buying a label posts NO stock movement
Packed -> Shipped
shipping moves the stock warehouse -> "<store> In Transit" (Bin)
Stock Ledger: one -10 at the warehouse and one +10 in transit
the ship Stock Entry is a submitted Material Transfer with a traceable remark
results.detail: {"stock_entry_type":"Material Transfer","from_warehouse":"HOU-WH - CCZ","to_warehouse":"OK-JENKS In Transit - CCZ","docstatus":1,"remarks":"Maison Shipment MSH-2026-00020 → OK-JENKS (in transit)"}

results.step: shipping is refused a second time (idempotent guard)
the shipment appears on the store's inbound (Receive) list once shipped
the store confirms receipt -> status Received
receiving moves the stock In Transit -> store (Bin), In Transit back to 0
Stock Ledger: one -10 in transit and one +10 at the store
no discrepancy is raised on a clean receipt
the replenishment request is closed out as Approved/complete
receiving the same shipment twice is refused and posts nothing
results.detail: 417 frappe.exceptions.ValidationError: Shipment MSH-2026-00020 is Received, not in transit; balances {"hq":60,"transit":0,"store":12}

results.step: KRT-001 is back above its reorder level at the store
shipping more than the warehouse holds is refused by the stock ledger (negative stock)
results.detail: 417 erpnext.stock.stock_ledger.NegativeStockError: 25.0 units of Item HKA-002: Starbuzz Carbine 2.0 Hookah needed in

results.step: the failed ship leaves the shipment in a workable state (not half-shipped)
a shipment can be cancelled mid-flow and posts no stock
a shipped/received consignment cannot be cancelled
results.detail: 417 frappe.exceptions.ValidationError: A shipped consignment cannot be cancelled — receive it at the store

results.step: the cancelled shipment leaves the wall columns
OBSERVATION: cancelling the shipment leaves its replenishment request "Approved"
results.detail: MRR-2026-00023 status=Approved (no re-open / no notification to the store)
